theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_fr_boundary_variation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (u : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Q ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) → Q.boundary.mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ V : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ s, 0 ≤ V p) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, V p) ≤ Q.boundary.mass ∧ ∀ p ∈ s, ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V p
